item.title: Xavier’s Sister Lynn Winsor announces retirement
item.description: Sister Lynn Winsor holds a national record 40 state championships from her 47 seasons as Xavier College Prep’s girl’s golf coach. After 52 years with the school, Winsor announced her plans for retirement.

item.title: In rural southern Arizona, Arivaca’s only doctor is retiring with no successor in place
item.description: Dr. Donald Smith has served this rural Arizona town for more than three decades and now struggles to find a replacement as he prepares to retire.

item.title: Mesa-native Randy Bennett set to be next ASU men’s coach
item.description: Arizona State has announced the hiring of St. Mary's coach Randy Bennett as the next men’s basketball coach.

item.title: ICE agents deployed at airports as funding impasse and security lines grow
item.description: ICE agents were deployed to at least 14 U.S. airports, including Phoenix, to assist the TSA during a shutdown-driven staffing shortage. The move drew sharp Democratic criticism, while travelers reported mostly normal security operations.

item.title: ICE agents getting paid while TSA does not at Sky Harbor
item.description: This sharp contrast has been a point of resentment for TSA union leaders, who are entering their sixth week without pay.

item.title: ASU’s new football facility ‘next step’ in becoming powerhouse
item.description: Coach Kenny Dillingham said ASU’s new football facility, projected for completion in spring 2028, will augment the program’s culture and the fan experience on ASU game days.

item.title: NBA players are returning to play college basketball
item.description: NBA players who have not made it are fighting eligibility rules to return to college.

item.title: Pitch velocity increase in baseball driven by training, biomechanics and spring training development
item.description: Pitchers are throwing harder than ever and modern training, biomechanics and spring training development are shaping how players build velocity from high school to the major leagues.

item.title: Cesar Chavez allegations unearth trauma for survivors.
item.description: Allegations against Cesar Chavez show a phenomenon is prevalent when celebrities or public figures are accused of sexual abuse.

item.title: Los organizadores se apresuran a proporcionar recursos a personas que experimentan la falta de vivienda en todo el Valle dos meses antes en medio de calor récord
item.description: El primer día de 105 grados en Phoenix llegó aproximadamente dos meses antes este año, dejando a organizaciones y voluntarios apresurándose para proporcionar recursos a personas que experimentan la falta de vivienda, quienes representan aproximadamente la mitad de las muertes por calor en el condado de Maricopa.
